title: Total Recording Time (TRT)
alternateFormula: TRT = TST + initial sleep latency + WASO
lesson: Total recording time is the elapsed interval from lights out to lights on. For report math, keep the entire interval in one unit before combining it with sleep latency, wake after sleep onset, or total sleep time.
memoryClue: TRT is the whole lights-out-to-lights-on window.
coachBobNote: When the clock crosses midnight, split the interval at midnight or convert both times to one continuous timeline.
